correctness.rationale: The exact renewal identity (4) follows from independent attempts; \(p_r\sim A/r\) is the stable small-time Levy one-jump rate. Conditional failed durations have mean 1+O(1/r) after multiplying r, variance approaching 1 and uniform exponential moments. The joint characteristic function limit is A/(A-i eta+xi^2/2). Independent success marks have Exp(1) microtime and Pareto excess. These steps jointly prove the six-component law. verify.py checks formulas in an exactly solvable competing-hazard case and numerical rate/moment identities; infinite claims rely on proof.
